answer: Make every agent earn passage through a karst cavern before it can trade: it must carry a beacon signal from one chamber to the next, each handoff checked by a different veteran who signs the relay, so no route can be faked in bulk. Each crossing burns one ember pass, minted only after real verified work, and a pass cannot be reused or copied, so a duplicate must earn fresh passage every time. Random cave audits re-check relays and freeze any whose signers repeat. Sybil farms must fund a beacon, burn an ember, and walk the caverns for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
